changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Stored values take the new names: the speaker HEPH is ANSWER, the model purpose MENTOR is CONVERSATION, the usage source MENTOR_TURN is CONVERSATION_TURN, and the subscription and email MENTOR_DIGEST is WEEKLY_DIGEST. A new configuration audit row names MODEL_ASSIGNMENT; the append-only audit log keeps earlier rows as written. Person-data requests and pending provider-event steps name the stores and steps by their new names. The function bodies that read the renamed tables and values change with them.

rollback.stop: Stop every role, restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup and start the previous release.
